comment: App Store screenshot captions per locale. This file is the source of truth (first drafted in the per-language plans, docs/archive/localization-2026-07/<lang>.md §4; tr puts the multicurrency frame first). Frame keys map to raw capture files: home=01-home, finances=02-finances, insights=03-insights, score=04-health-score, topcat=05-top-category, history=06-history, voice=07-voice (Ten's voice sheet), fx=08-multicurrency, ten=13-ten-answer, draft=14-ten-draft, goal=15-goal, debts=16-debts. At most 10 frames per locale go to the store. `header` is the phrase of the store's header art (scripts/compose_store_art.py). Custom product page frames: subscriptions=09-subscriptions, subscription=10-subscription-detail, deposit=11-deposit, loans=12-loans, and Ten's answers tensubs=17-ten-subscriptions, tenfx=18-ten-currencies, tenloan=19-ten-loan; the pages and their frame order are in appstore/product-pages.json.
